status: Private implementation contract; no physical/provider/public/owner admission
ownership: providers/windows/storage_identity derives composite reported evidence from actual owned /2 frames. The existing Windows host owns reader lifetimes, runtime owns capture coordination, and original frames/graph observations remain immutable. No new host channel, product composition or public fingerprint ABI.
construction: Only an actual StorageFrameSnapshot can create an immutable identity observation. Require exact expected source/capture/worker, complete frame digest and owned context digest. JSON, a pure replay validator and a subject path cannot manufacture this type. Retain the original frame binding and native worker context.
facts: Each disk/volume retains component states, original conflicts and its lookup label/number separately from selected identity facts. Normalize exact descriptor names/raw-property digest, all identifier bytes/code/type/association, reported capacity/sector facts and active layout metadata. Sort identifier and active partition values without dropping duplicates. Exclude subject label/key, number hints, ID offsets/ordinals, layout entry ordinals/number/rewrite/recognition/hidden hints and reply packaging from the selected reported fingerprint; complete original frame digest still binds every omitted field/receipt. Controller/path/LUN/namespace facts not captured by this profile remain explicitly not_observed.
collisions: Bounded groups retain every occurrence of nonempty reported ASCII serials, nonzero device-associated identifiers, nonzero MBR/GPT disk IDs, active nonzero partition GUIDs and whole-disk number hints. Identifier tokens include code/type/association. Shared values mean possible alias/clone, not proved same or distinct media. Preserve duplicates within one row and across rows. Different associations/types/bytes must not merge. No graph or media identity coalescence.
quality: Classify conflicting critical reported facts before ambiguous repeated candidates, then insufficient selected observations, otherwise complete_selected_reports. Original conflicts and component states remain visible. Complete selected reports require a disk, observed descriptor/geometry/length/identifiers/alignment/layout, conformant descriptor name encodings and at least one nonzero supported device-associated identifier; a serial, map GUID, number or path alone is insufficient. Volume identity is not selected here. This is completeness of selected reports, never completeness/credibility of physical identity.
comparison: Bind exact previous/current immutable observation digests and explicitly named disk subjects under caller-declared lookup continuity. Sources must match, current capture must not precede previous, and current worker epoch must advance. Reject forged bindings, missing subjects, reversed/same attempts or profile confusion. Retain per-component selected-field changes and a separate exact reported_relation. Applicable relation is incomparable if either row is conflicting, ambiguous or insufficient; otherwise unchanged-reported-evidence or changed-reported-evidence. Same reported fingerprint is not media identity, current freshness, atomic acquisition or authority. Historical observations remain true evidence after newer captures.
limits: Reuse 16 subjects and 128 frame details, existing reader/job/parent/capture/graph/display limits. Identity values use the existing 786432-byte/40000-value/depth24 frame ceiling and 32768-byte maximum strings so exact retained labels/identifier keys are not truncated. Comparison uses the same ceiling. Native probe admits at most eight stages, 1 MiB input and 4 MiB output with explicit budget refusal, never truncation.
expected_checks: Actual separately owned x64/x86 /2 reader stages and real capture keys/context/code/native PID/creation bindings; pure derivation/comparison dispatch no API call.

Independent fingerprints/groups/component differences for unchanged, changed IDs/serial/capacity/sector/layout/name/attribute fields; reordered rows/IDs/partitions and changed lookup hints preserve selected fingerprints but change full frame bindings.

Missing/absent/empty/zero/unsupported/other-associated IDs, absent or nonconformant serials, duplicate serials/IDs/GUIDs/numbers and contradictions retain their exact quality/scope; weak singleton hints never qualify a physical target.

Every selected identifier and active partition remains represented, including 64 partitions, more than eight IDs, 256-byte IDs, all 36 UTF16 name units and the 128-detail frame limit. Exhaustion, malformed, denied, cancelled, pending/late/superseded/held/startup/hung cases remain explicit.
Wrong expected frame/context/key/observation digests, subject and reversed/same epochs refuse without changing originals; old capture cannot create a current owned frame.

Original /1, /2 frame, cached frontend, owned raw provenance, raw comparison and shared namespace/lifecycle regressions; exact source/build/PE/import/tooling/context/manifest evidence. Reuse product evidence only through all unchanged inputs.
